terminal_reason: MEASURED 2026-09-30 ~05:55Z (lane STAGE2-MIRROR, dispatched by the manager to measure instead of ask). Sources: /api/bot/trades/closed?account_id=alpaca_portfolio&include_paper=true (66 rows, opened 2026-07-16..2026-09-21) and /api/diag/journal trades + order_packages (newest 1000 each; trades back to 2026-09-01). Each trade re-sized through RiskManager.position_size with alpaca_live's risk block at its measured $193.56 equity/buying power (diag broker_account_status 2026-09-30T05:36Z, cash, multiplier 1), whole shares, side_filter long -- the same method as R-AFFORD (#14543). POPULATION A -- strict-roster trades (legs on alpaca_live's roster; strict roster merged #12687 2026-09-22T00:21Z): ief_pullback_1d and slv_pullback_1d produced ZERO order packages since the cut and alpaca_portfolio opened ZERO trades since 2026-09-21T14:25Z. The only roster-leg trade in the window is #5874 slv_pullback_1d SLV long @59.27 (opened 09-17, closed 09-28): sizer gives 1 share, and alpaca_live ACTUALLY TOOK the identical trade (#5875, 1 sh @59.27, same bar). Result A: total 1, would-size 1, would-refuse 0 (cash wall 0, T+1 0, side_filter 0). POPULATION B -- mirror trades closed >= 2026-09-21 or still open, from legs CUT from the mirror at 2026-09-22 (pre-cut legacy): total 6, would-size 0, refuse 6 = cash_wall 4 (GLD 400.43, QQQ 734.57/716.41, SPY 759.89), sizer risk-budget 1 (GDX, stop too wide for the round-up at 2%), side_filter 1 (#5912 TLT short, journal status still open). These are exactly the legs the 2026-09-21 roster cut removed, so they end with the cut. Why this closes: MD-DEMOTE-S2-S1 reads each leg's OWN last-40 mirror trades, so off-roster legacy trades never enter a roster leg's Gate-2 read. For roster legs, n=1 and 0 divergent. The remaining forward risk has two parts. (a) Shorts: #14539 gives alpaca_portfolio side_filter: long. (b) Unaffordable promotions: #14543's R-AFFORD refuses a leg alpaca_live cannot size. T+1 was never observed binding. Caveat, stated: n=1 is small; the reopen trigger is a roster-leg mirror trade with no matching alpaca_live fill. Proposed fix, NOT needed now: if it ever diverges, filtering the Gate-2 read to live-sizeable trades is SAFER for the demotion signal than sizing the mirror at live's basis. Filtering keeps the mirror's honest-size P&L and drops only trades live could not take. Sizing the mirror at ~$194 would round most setups to 0-2 shares, starving the demotion window of n.
what: Stage-2 Alpaca mirror still is not trade-identical after #14539 makes every CONFIG trade-shaping field equal. Three NON-config inputs to Coordinator.multi_account_execute differ between alpaca_live and alpaca_portfolio: (1) ALPACA_CASH_SETTLEMENT_ACCOUNTS (env) binds the T+1 sizing basis on alpaca_live only (accounts.yaml alpaca_live comment: the mirror measured negative venue_cash and would halt under `apply`); (2) cash vs margin buying power: alpaca_live is multiplier 1, $193.56 equity (diag broker_account_status 2026-09-30T05:36Z), so the whole-share cash wall refuses on live what the paper book sizes; (3) the venue shorting_enabled flag (false on live) -- moot for opens while both carry side_filter: long. Gate 2 reads the mirror's net-of-cost window as the demotion signal, so (1)-(2) mean it can include trades live could not size.
why_it_matters: B2 (operator 2026-09-21) requires IDENTICAL trades; a demotion signal read off trades the live book could not take is a different book's P&L.
